# Testium Tech

> AI-first software development company building AI agents, custom platforms, mobile apps and enterprise automation for ambitious teams.

Testium Tech designs, builds and scales AI-native software products. We ship flagship products like Nexi AI (AI CRM), FinFlow AI (finance automation), EduSelf (online education platform), IPE School and Dildoras Bot, and we deliver Claude cowork training, Telegram + CRM automation for course creators, and end-to-end business automation for clients who want to own — not rent — their software.
